harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established a persistent AIDE integrity baseline for /etc on node1. The final baseline contains 1,452 entries, performs SHA-256/SHA-512 content verification plus security-metadata checks, reports to /var/log/aide/aide.log and stdout/journal, and runs through an enabled persistent daily timer. Final reboot verification was clean.
actions_performed: Created a root-owned, mode-600 baseline database.
Verified detection and reporting of a controlled existing-file content change, including changed SHA-256 and SHA-512 hashes.
Removed the test file and regenerated a clean production baseline.
Refined the policy to exclude reboot-only inode/timestamp noise while retaining content and security metadata checks.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified the final configuration, database, timer, and clean integrity state persisted.

evidence.summary: Installed the native RHEL 10 AIDE package successfully.

evidence.requirement: Later changes to files under /etc can be identified and reported
evidence.summary: A controlled content modification was reported as one changed file with before/after size, SHA-256, and SHA-512 values.

evidence.requirement: Final clean /etc baseline and scheduled reporting
evidence.summary: The 1,452-entry baseline returned rc=0 with no differences; the persistent daily timer is enabled and active, and the service completed successfully.

evidence.requirement: node1 final restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot ID was 805b3728-8300-455b-80f2-796baffb0d8e; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 2666091a-a8db-4b85-bf94-65e22dfaed80. The baseline hash remained abf000faf9c81e2f6774c37243cdaa029ca9a4e9ddc1c620b9edc49aa4aadde2, the timer recovered active/enabled, the service returned success, and AIDE reported no differences.
